newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MONACO UPSET BY SECOND DIVISION LAVAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO UPSET BY SECOND DIVISION LAVAL.

text.p: Monaco crashed out of the French Cup 1-0 away to second division Laval on Friday.
France's international goalkeeper Fabien Barthez gave away a penalty in the 10th minute converted by Jean-Louis Lima.

Monaco, French first division leaders and UEFA Cup quarter-finalists, dominated most of the match but Laval, 15th in the second division, held out with goalkeeper Christophe Gardier making several stunning saves.
Barthez was up in the Laval box for the last nail-biting minutes when Monaco won a string of corners. But the goalkeeper failed to make up for his earlier blunder with a face-saving equaliser.
The 31 other matches in the first round, when the first division clubs come into the competition, were scheduled for Saturday and Sunday.
